provenance: An explicit family of accelerated finite-dimensional filtrations on k[x] realizing the full extended nonnegative entropy spectrum, correcting unrestricted entropy-to-growth claims in arXiv:2609.18144v1 and giving a universal-quantifier repair.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Filtration dependence, linear reindexing of entropy, standard filtered-GK comparison theorems, and the need for associated-graded finiteness hypotheses are prior art. The primary Krause--Lenagan Proposition 6.6 text was not independently inspected; later accessible citations quote a finite-generation hypothesis. The construction is elementary and may have an equivalent older formulation under different filtration terminology. Results restricted to standard or natural filtrations, including the Leavitt-path-algebra setting, are not claimed to fail. No independent validation is asserted.
